standard.value: National Boards English language skills (ELS) registration standard (version dated 18 March 2025) applies to Australian-trained graduates as well as overseas-trained applicants; does not apply to students
standard.quote: To get registration in Australia, every applicant must meet their National Board’s English language skills standard. This includes Australian-trained or overseas qualified applicants.

standardVersion.value: English language skills registration standard – 18 March 2025
standardVersion.quote: English language skills registration standard – 18 March 2025

professionsCovered.quote: This standard sets out how you can show this to the Board and applies to the following professions:

pathways.quote: The combined education pathway The school education pathway The advanced education pathway, and The test pathway.

combinedEducationPathway.value: At least 2 years of secondary education (Australian years 7-12 or equivalent) taught and assessed solely in English in a recognised country, AND the professional qualification taught and assessed solely in English in a recognised country. An international student who did only the degree in Australia does NOT meet this unless they also have 2 years of English-medium secondary schooling in a recognised country.
combinedEducationPathway.quote: at least two years of your secondary education which was taught and assessed solely in English in a recognised country , and your qualification(s) for your profession, which were taught and assessed solely in English in a recognised country .

advancedEducationPathway.value: At least 6 years in total (full-time equivalent) of education taught and assessed solely in English in a recognised country, including the professional qualification and AQF level 7+ tertiary education; max 2-year break; last period completed no more than 2 years before applying for registration.
advancedEducationPathway.quote: The last period of education must have been completed no more than two years before applying for registration.

schoolEducationPathway.value: English is main language AND at least 10 years of primary and secondary school taught and assessed solely in English in a recognised country.
schoolEducationPathway.quote: at least 10 years of your primary and secondary school education which was taught and assessed solely in English in a recognised country

testScoresTakenOnOrAfter2026-04-23.quote: Minimum test scores for tests taken on or after 23 April 2026.

pteScoreQuote.value: PTE Academic new minimums: overall 63; L58 R59 W60 S76
pteScoreQuote.quote: PTE Academic Overall: 63 Listening: 58 Reading: 59 Writing: 60 Speaking: 76

oetScoreQuote.value: OET new minimums: L350 R360 W350 S360 (any profession-specific OET)

scoreChangeEffective.value: New minimum scores apply to tests taken on or after 23 April 2026; tests taken on or before 22 April 2026 are assessed against the old minimums (e.g. IELTS 7 each band except writing 6.5; OET B / writing C+; PTE 66 overall and L/R/S 66, writing 56 per OTC copy of Table 1).
scoreChangeEffective.quote: Changes to the minimum scores required are in effect from 23 April 2026.

twoSittings.value: Results accepted from one sitting, or a maximum of two sittings within 12 months subject to per-test floor scores
twoSittings.quote: a maximum of two test sittings in a 12-month period only if:

testValidity.value: Test results generally valid for two years before the date of lodging the registration application
testValidity.quote: English language test results are valid for two years before the date you lodge your application for registration.

migrationTestReuse.value: Test results obtained for a skilled migration visa in the past two years can be reused if they meet the standard
migrationTestReuse.quote: If you sat one of these tests as part of your application for a skilled migration visa in the past two years and you achieved the requirements and results specified in the standard, you can use those results and do not need to sit another test.

exemptions.value: Exemption may be granted only for limited registration (demonstration of clinical techniques, research with limited/no patient contact, postgraduate study/examination/assessment or supervised practice). Not available for general registration of a new graduate. Not required again if ELS standard previously met without conditions (e.g. moving provisional to general).
exemptions.quote: The Board may grant an exemption to this standard when you apply for limited registration in the following circumstances:

provisionalToGeneral.value: No need to re-meet ELS when moving from provisional to general registration in the same profession
provisionalToGeneral.quote: For example, you hold provisional registration and are applying for general registration

graduateRegistration.value: Graduates register with their profession's National Board via the Ahpra portal; can apply up to 90 days before completing the course. Pharmacy and psychology graduates have extra supervised-practice requirements; other professions in this group apply for registration on completing an approved program.
graduateRegistration.quote: Pharmacy and psychology graduates have additional requirements and should apply once your supervised practice arrangements are signed off.

applyEarly.value: Apply up to 90 days before course completion
applyEarly.quote: We recommend getting your application in early, up to 90 days before the time you expect to complete all your course requirements, which includes any placements.

elsForGraduates.value: ELS standard applies regardless of Australian training
elsForGraduates.quote: You must meet the ELS registration standard for your profession, regardless of whether you are Australian-trained or qualified overseas.

stream.value: International Student Stream: for graduates of an accredited/approved pharmacy degree in Australia (as an international student) or NZ; registered or eligible to be registered
stream.quote: You graduated from a recognised pharmacy degree program in Australia or New Zealand as an international student.

eligibility.value: Must hold an approved pharmacy degree (graduated; incomplete degree not eligible). Recent graduate, provisionally or fully registered pharmacist may apply.
eligibility.quote: You might be a recent graduate, or a provisionally or fully registered pharmacist.

incompleteDegree.quote: If your degree is incomplete, you are not eligible for a Skills Assessment outcome.

workExperience.value: Not required. Optional Australian work-experience verification ($200) only counts work as a fully registered retail or hospital pharmacist (not intern), >20 h/week, at least 12 months in last 10 years
workExperience.quote: International students do not need to have worked as a pharmacist to apply for a skills assessment.

fee.value: Eligibility Check and Skills Assessment Outcome: AUD 1110; work experience verification AUD 200
fee.quote: Eligibility Check and Skills Assessment Outcome: $1110

notForRegistration.value: SAO is for visa/migration purposes only; not required for registration
notForRegistration.quote: It is not required for pharmacist registration.

qualification.value: Board-approved pharmacy program of study; the program is approved either for provisional registration (then internship) or for general registration (registration exam still required)
qualification.quote: The type of registration that a graduate of an approved program must apply for depends on whether the Board has approved the program for:

type.value: Provisional registration for the internship, then general registration
type.quote: when applying for provisional registration to undertake an internship

internship.value: Accredited intern training program plus Board-approved supervised practice
internship.quote: the period of supervised practice must include satisfactory completion of an accredited intern training program

supervisedHours.value: 1,824 hours normally; a modified requirement of 1,575 hours remains in place until a revised supervised practice standard is implemented
supervisedHours.quote: The current modified requirement of 1,575 hours of Board-approved supervised practice for general registration will remain in place until a revised registration standard addressing supervised practice arrangements that has been approved by Ministers is implemented.

exams.value: Must pass written and oral registration examinations before general registration
exams.quote: passed both registration examinations (written examination and oral examination)

unsupervisedPractice.value: Cannot practise unsupervised until general registration is granted
unsupervisedPractice.quote: You cannot work unsupervised as a pharmacist until you have been granted general registration.

english.value: Must meet Ahpra English Language Skills Registration Standard for physiotherapists
english.quote: Meet Ahpra’s English Language Skills Registration Standard for physiotherapists.

australianGraduateCriterion.value: Hold a physiotherapy qualification completed in Australia that is on the Physiotherapy Board of Australia Approved Programs of Study list (general registration not itself listed as a criterion)
australianGraduateCriterion.quote: physiotherapy qualification that was completed in Australia and is included in the Physiotherapy Board of Australia's Approved Programs of Study List under the profession 'Physiotherapist'

workExperience.value: Not required unless claiming skilled employment
workExperience.quote: You do not need to provide evidence of work experience unless you’re claiming ‘skilled employment’ on your visa application.

interimCertificate.quote: No, the Interim Certificate is not applicable for a Skills Assessment.

qualification.value: Ahpra/Physiotherapy Board approved program of study at an accredited Australian (or NZ) university

registration.type: general (graduate of approved program; see shared.AhpraNationalScheme)

scope.value: Desktop assessment of OT qualification and English proficiency; applies to Australian-qualified international students too
scope.quote: The Assessment for migration (Skills assessment) is a desktop assessment of an applicant’s occupational therapy qualification and evidence of English language proficiency.

registrationNotSubstitute.value: Australian qualification or Ahpra general registration does NOT replace the skills assessment
registrationNotSubstitute.quote: you must obtain one regardless of whether you hold an Australian occupational therapy qualification or general registration with Ahpra

registrationNotRequired.value: Registration is not required to apply
registrationNotRequired.quote: A skills assessment does not require you to hold Australian registration.

qualificationCriteria.value: Comparability to AQF Level 7 and WFOT approval status
qualificationCriteria.quote: This includes consideration of the qualification’s comparability to an Australian Qualifications Framework (AQF) Level 7 qualification, World Federation of Occupational Therapists (WFOT) approval status

englishTestByAssessor.value: Yes - evidence of English proficiency required by OTC (education pathways per OTC "Pathways to evidence English language proficiency" mirroring Ahpra ELS, or test). Updated scores apply to tests taken on/after 23 April 2026.
englishTestByAssessor.quote: The updated English language test score requirements apply only to tests taken on or after 23 April 2026.

workExperience.quote: The skills assessment is based on your occupational therapy qualification only.

validity.quote: A positive skills assessment outcome is generally valid for three years from the date of issue

qualification.value: OT qualification comparable to an Australian Bachelor or Graduate Entry Master's degree (per OTC explanatory notes PDF); assessed against AQF Level 7 comparability

registration.type: general (graduate of approved program; see shared.AhpraNationalScheme)

requiredToPractise.value: Registration with OTBA through Ahpra required to practise
requiredToPractise.quote: Practitioners must hold registration with the Occupational Therapy Board of Australia (OTBA) through the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) to practise in Australia.

australianGraduateStream.value: ASMIRT assesses international students who graduated from an Australian university accredited undergraduate program (details page not yet live)
australianGraduateStream.quote: International students who have graduated with an Australian University Undergraduate Accredited Program

pageStatus.value: Assessment page under review; links not accessible until 30 October (2026)
pageStatus.quote: This page is currently under review and the links are not accessible.

scope.value: Assessing authority for diagnostic radiography/medical imaging, radiation therapy and sonography
scope.quote: ASMIRT is the Assessing Authority for overseas applicants wishing to practice Diagnostic Radiography/Medical Imaging, Radiation Therapy and Ultrasound (Sonography) in Australia.

registration.board: Medical Radiation Practice Board of Australia (radiographer, radiation therapist only)

divisions.quote: The Board has three divisions of practice, and registered practitioners must be qualified in at least one of the following divisions: diagnostic radiography radiation therapy nuclear medicine technology

registration.type: general (graduate of approved program; see shared.AhpraNationalScheme)

criterion.value: Qualifications comparable to an Australian six-year psychology sequence, OR unconditional general registration with Ahpra
criterion.quote: you must demonstrate that your qualifications are comparable to a six-year sequence of study in psychology in Australia, or that you hold unconditional general registration with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA).

englishTestByAssessor.value: APS page says English must be demonstrated via a recognised test (IELTS, PTE etc.) aligned with practice requirements; page does not state an exemption for Australian-registered applicants
englishTestByAssessor.quote: The English language proficiency requirements align with the requirements to practice as a psychologist in Australia.

endorsementForSpecialistCodes.value: Clinical (272311), Educational (272312), Organisational (272313) require the corresponding Ahpra area of practice endorsement; otherwise assessed as Psychologists nec (272399)
endorsementForSpecialistCodes.quote: To receive a skills assessment under the occupation of Clinical Psychologist (272311), Educational Psychologist (272312) or Organisational Psychologist (272313) you must hold the corresponding area of practice endorsement with AHPRA. If no endorsement is held, the skills assessment will confirm suitability for migration under Psychologist nec (272399).

sequence.value: Six-year sequence: 4-year accredited sequence then 2 further years as provisional psychologist via higher degree pathway (e.g. 2-year Masters, or Doctorate) or 5+1 internship
sequence.quote: This typically includes a four-year Board-approved accredited sequence of study in psychology followed by a further two years of Board approved education and training undertaken while registered as a provisional psychologist

higherDegree.value: Higher degree pathway: postgraduate degree accredited at 5th and 6th year level (two-year Masters) or higher (3-4 year Doctorate)
higherDegree.quote: an approved postgraduate degree accredited at the fifth and sixth year level (such as a two-year Masters) or higher (such as a three or four year Doctorate)

fourPlusTwoClosed.value: 4+2 closed to new applicants 30 June 2022; current interns must apply for general registration before 30 June 2027
fourPlusTwoClosed.quote: The 4+2 internship pathway closed to new applicants on 30 June 2022.

fourPlusTwoDeadline.quote: apply for general registration prior to 30 June 2027

nationalExam.value: Internship pathway (5+1) candidates must pass the national psychology exam
nationalExam.quote: Those completing one of the internship pathways will need to pass the national psychology exam before applying for general registration.

type.value: Provisional registration during training, then general registration
type.quote: undertaken while registered as a provisional psychologist

endorsementEligibility.value: Area of practice endorsement requires general registration, an approved 6th-year-or-higher qualification in the area, and a Board-approved registrar program
endorsementEligibility.quote: have completed a period of Board-approved supervised practice through the registrar program, or comparable supervised practice (unless exempt under the transition provisions noted below).

registrarMasters.value: Masters (approved to sixth year): registrar program 88 weeks minimum, 3000 hours, 80 h supervision, 80 h CPD
registrarMasters.quote: Masters Degree Approved to sixth year 88 weeks 3000 hours 80 hours 80 hours

internshipToEndorsement.value: 4+2/5+1 graduates need an approved one-year postgraduate (bridging) qualification plus registrar program
internshipToEndorsement.quote: may complete an approved one-year postgraduate qualification and the registrar program to be eligible to apply for endorsement

australianGraduateRoute.value: Australian general dental qualification: skills assessment only (no exam pathway)
australianGraduateRoute.quote: You have completed a general dental qualification in Australia.

documents.value: Includes evidence of registration/licence and work history, two professional references, certificate of good standing sent directly by regulator; specialists add AHPRA dental specialist registration certificate
documents.quote: AHPRA dental specialist registration certificate (if you are applying as a dental specialist)

validity.quote: your skills assessment is valid for three years from the date of issue

qualification.value: General dental qualification completed in Australia (Board-approved program)
qualification.quote: You have completed a general dental qualification in Australia.

registration.type: general (dentist); specialist registration for dental specialists

australianGraduateRoute.value: Recent Australian qualification from a recognised accredited program, or current unconditional Australian registration: exempt from Competency Based Assessment (desktop audit only)
australianGraduateRoute.quote: Candidates who hold a recent Australian/New Zealand qualification from a recognised accredited program or current registration without conditions in Australia or New Zealand are exempt from the Competency Based Assessment.

englishTestByAssessor.quote: Candidates are not required to provide evidence of English language proficiency to CCEA.

workReferences.value: Chiropractic work experience references no longer required
workReferences.quote: Chiropractic work experience references are NO longer required.

registration.type: general (graduate of approved program; see shared.AhpraNationalScheme)

rule.value: OCANZ skills assessment required for GSM unless currently registered with the Optometry Board of Australia (registered applicants use Form 1 with OBA registration certificate)
rule.quote: you must apply to the Optometry Council of Australia and New Zealand (OCANZ) for a Skills Assessment. Unless you are currently registered with the Optometry Board of Australia.

form1.value: Form 1 for optometrists currently registered in Australia; requires OBA certificate of registration
form1.quote: For optometrists currently registered in Australia and requiring a skills assessment for migration purposes.

registrationCertificate.value: Certificate of registration as an optometrist with the Optometry Board of Australia (issued by AHPRA)
registrationCertificate.quote: Certificate of registration as an optometrist with the Optometry Board of Australia (issued by AHPRA

registration.type: general (graduate of approved program; see shared.AhpraNationalScheme)

rule.value: Answer YES to at least one: hold current full (unconditional) practising certificate from Osteopathy Board of Australia; OR completed a recognised, registrable entry-level osteopathy qualification at an Australian university. Submit Form 1A.
rule.quote: You have completed a recognized, registrable, entry-level qualification in osteopathy at a university in Australia

registrationOption.quote: You currently hold a current and full (unconditional) practicing certificate as an osteopath from the Osteopathy Board of Australia

processing.quote: The assessment for skilled migration can take up to 15 working days

qualification.value: Recognised, registrable entry-level osteopathy qualification at an Australian university
qualification.quote: recognized, registrable, entry-level qualification in osteopathy

registration.type: general (graduate of approved program; see shared.AhpraNationalScheme)

rule.value: No separate assessment: Home Affairs accepts a CMBA certificate of general registration (acupuncturist, Chinese herbal medicine practitioner or Chinese herbal dispenser) as the skills assessment
rule.quote: The Department of Home Affairs will accept the following evidence from the Board as evidence of a suitable skills assessment:

assessment.englishTestByAssessor: Not separate - covered by registration ELS standard

workExperienceVerification.value: Optional APC work verification counts only fully registered retail or hospital pharmacist work
workExperienceVerification.quote: as a fully registered retail or hospital pharmacist (not as an intern)

differences.note: No official difference found from Retail Pharmacist for the International Student Stream; same SAO process.

ahpraRegistered.quote: Within the registers, Chinese medicine, dental, medical radiation and nursing professions are further categorised into divisions.

differences.ahpraRegisteredNote: Confirmed by omission: sonography is not among the MRPB divisions (diagnostic radiography, radiation therapy, nuclear medicine technology) nor the protected titles, and no Sonography profession appears in Ahpra Professions and divisions list. No Ahpra registration or Ahpra ELS standard applies; ASMIRT assesses sonography.

default.value: Default code if no area of practice endorsement
default.quote: If no endorsement is held, the skills assessment will confirm suitability for migration under Psychologist nec (272399).

endorsementRequired.value: Clinical psychology area of practice endorsement (Ahpra) required
endorsementRequired.quote: you must hold the corresponding area of practice endorsement with AHPRA

endorsementRequired.value: Educational and developmental psychology area of practice endorsement required
endorsementRequired.quote: you must hold the corresponding area of practice endorsement with AHPRA

endorsementRequired.value: Organisational psychology area of practice endorsement required
endorsementRequired.quote: you must hold the corresponding area of practice endorsement with AHPRA

assessorDocument.quote: AHPRA dental specialist registration certificate (if you are applying as a dental specialist)

specialistRegistration.value: Specialist registration needs a qualification in the specialty plus all general-registration requirements as a dentist, and minimum 2 years general dental practice
specialistRegistration.quote: completed a minimum of two years general dental practice

qualification.value: Qualification in one of 13 approved specialties
qualification.quote: All applicants for specialist registration must hold a qualification in the specialty and meet all the requirements for general registration as a dentist.

evidence.value: Certificate of general registration as an acupuncturist
evidence.quote: Certificate of general registration as an acupuncturist

evidence.value: Certificate of general registration as a Chinese herbal medicine practitioner or Chinese herbal dispenser (or acupuncturist)
evidence.quote: Certificate of general registration as a Chinese herbal medicine practitioner

differences.titleNote: CMBA page names 252214 as "Chinese medicine practitioner".

gaps: Ahpra ELS for international students: an Australian degree alone usually does NOT satisfy the combined education pathway (needs 2+ years English-medium secondary schooling in a recognised country) - most will need the test pathway or advanced education pathway (6 years FTE). This is an interpretation of the standard text, not an Ahpra statement about international students specifically.

Old (pre-23 April 2026) score table: only read from the OTC PDF copy (Table 1: IELTS 7/each except writing 6.5; OET B, writing C+; PTE 66 overall and L/R/S 66, writing 56; Cambridge 185, writing 176). Not quoted because the PDF text extraction garbles ligatures; the Ahpra transition arrangements policy PDF was not read.

ASMIRT: assessment page is "under review" with links inactive until 30 October 2026, so ASMIRT requirements for Australian-graduate international students (documents, English, registration evidence, sonography specifics such as ASAR accreditation) could not be confirmed. All ASMIRT assessment fields beyond scope are null.
Sonographer non-registration confirmed only by omission (no sonography division/profession on Ahpra and MRPB lists); no page found that explicitly says "sonographers are not registered".
APS: page does not state whether applicants holding Australian general registration are exempt from its English test statement; english field records the APS wording only.
ADC, OCANZ, AOAC: assessor pages state no English test of their own; recorded as null (not confirmed either way).
OCANZ: whether an Australian graduate not yet registered can use Form 1 is not stated; page implies registration with the Optometry Board is the route.
APC (physio) criteria mention an approved Australian qualification but do not require general registration; fact sheet PDF not read.

Nominal course durations: not stated on any official assessor/board page read except psychology (4-year sequence + 2 years; two-year Masters; 3-4 year Doctorate). All other nominalDuration fields null.
Hospital vs Retail Pharmacist: no official difference found on APC pages; both use the same International Student Stream SAO.

Medical radiation, physio, OT, dental, chiro, optometry, osteopathy, Chinese medicine: graduate registration type (general on completion of an approved program) is inferred from the Ahpra graduate page singling out pharmacy and psychology as having additional requirements; individual board graduate pages were not read.
Home Affairs pages were not consulted; skills assessment validity periods are as stated by assessors (OTC, ADC: 3 years).
CMBA immigration page was last reviewed 18/03/2025.
